high_current._rule: A net is high-current if it has a zone, any track >= min_track_width_mm, or is listed here (schematic role power/ground; circuit-context.json carries no net roles yet, so the list is explicit).

high_dvdt._rule: Explicit seed list per board (audit §6.1): BQ_SW, BOOST_SW, the U5 SW pads 19/20, LED_DATA, USB_DP/USB_DN, CHRG_INT. LED data after the level shifter and the MCU-side USB pair are included as the same signals.

definitions.neighbour_measure: plan view, across all copper layers; the layer separation is reported with each neighbour
definitions.clearance: copper edge to copper edge (tracks buffered by width/2, true pad polygons, via annular rings, zone fills)
